caption: mountain-bike combat racing - pedal down the mountain, kick the rivals, pray for the landing.
about: Downhill domination (2003) is the ps2's answer to the extreme-sports era: downhill mountain-bike races down real-scale mountains, combat allowed - kicks, punches, thrown water bottles - and speed earned by picking braver lines. The vertical drop design and the trick system hold up as the genre's best bike entry.
No windows build exists, so the platform is ps2 - played through pcsx2, rom sourced from romsfun.
